subject: Invoice gate preflight: PO timing / stage sweep for Maple Health
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice gate preflight: PO timing / stage sweep for Maple Health

Team —

Quick note on the Maple Health booking we need to get across the invoice gate this month. Finance is asking for a clean PO + billing instructions to recognize the April 30 booking. Current status I have:
- Sales stage: Contracting (SOW v3 sent 3/28)
- Procurement: procurement looped in, working on internal PO
- Legal: redlines done, DocuSign awaiting signatures

Action items I need from each of you by EOD Wed (4/4):
1) Marissa — confirm whether customer has sign-off on SOW reference and any invoicing name/ship-to details.
2) Ben — please confirm expected PO receipt date and whether partial invoices are acceptable or we must wait for full PO.
3) Vanessa — please flag any revenue recognition blockers you see (PO format, billing contact mismatch, or required T&Cs).

Attached: Maple_Health_MAP_v2.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOW_MapleHealth_v3.pdf.

Goal: have prebill package ready for finance on Thu 4/5 so we can issue invoice the week of 4/8 if PO arrives. If PO slips past 4/10, we risk pushing the booking to May recognition.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice gate preflight: PO timing / stage sweep for Maple Health

On Mon, Apr 2, 2028 at 9:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick note on the Maple Health booking we need to get across the invoice gate this month....

Dylan — quick update from my side:
- Customer procurement confirmed commercial terms on 4/1; they asked to align invoice reference to SOW_MapleHealth_v3 (they provided a PO template).
- Legal has signed off on the latest T&Cs; signatures pending on the customer side (DocuSign out).
- Customer asked that the invoice include the project code "MH-2028-44" in the line item description.

Open question: procurement asked whether we can split into two invoices (50/50) because they have separate budget owners signing POs. Customer said they prefer single PO but can accept split invoices if we indicate both in the statement of work. Can finance accept split billing for recognition purposes?

Attaching internal prebill_checklist.xlsx with items I used to validate readiness.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Liz Hamilton <liz.hamilton@maplehealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Maple Health Procurement <procurement@maplehealth.org>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice gate preflight: PO timing / stage sweep for Maple Health

Hi Marissa / Dylan / Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Procurement has routed the PO for final approval and we expect to issue the PO by Friday 4/6.

A few notes for invoicing:
- Please reference SOW_MapleHealth_v3 and project code MH-2028-44 on the invoice.
- Billing name: Maple Health Network, Attn: Accounts Payable
- PO number will be provided in the PO email; if the PO comes in after 4/6 we will still issue it but it may not be processed internally until 4/12.
- Split invoices are acceptable but Maple Health prefers one consolidated invoice if possible.

If you need a hard copy or vendor portal details, let me know and I will fast-track.

Best,
Liz Hamilton
Director, Procurement
Maple Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice gate preflight: PO timing / stage sweep for Maple Health

Thanks all — good signal from the customer. Quick next steps from finance ops perspective:

- Marissa: please confirm once DocuSign has the customer's signature and paste the DocuSign link into the deal record (HubSpot).
- Liz / Maple Health: once PO is available, please send to finance@redwood.com and cc procurement@maplehealth.org. Finance will prepare a prebill package with the following required fields: PO number, billing name/address, SOW reference, project code, and invoice distribution email.
- Vanessa: if we need to do split invoicing, flag whether the revenue recognition team needs to build a contract modification.

I will open a prebill ticket and attach the prebill_checklist.xlsx and SOW_MapleHealth_v3.pdf so accounts payable has everything in one place. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.company/deal/RWI-DEAL-2028-0441
DocuSign placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC12345

If PO arrives by 4/6 and DocuSign completes, we will target invoice issuance week of 4/8 and include the booking in April recognition. If PO slips beyond 4/10, we will triage and advise on potential impact to the booking month.

Ben Carter
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: prebill_checklist.xlsx, SOW_MapleHealth_v3.pdf
